subject: Marketplace co-sell — micro-window arbitration & rehearsal plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda@cloudbridge.com>, Nimbus Data Sales <demo@nimbusdata.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace co-sell — micro-window arbitration & rehearsal plan

Hi Amanda / Nimbus team —

Great to get this moving. We want to make the joint marketplace demo feel tight for customer execs while still giving the SI enough time for their integration callouts. Proposal below is intentionally micro-windowed to keep ops smooth and preserve regional overlap:

Proposed primary demo (45m + 15m ops buffer) — pick one:
- Option A: Tue Dec 14, 10:00–11:00 PT (13:00–14:00 ET) — default host: Redwood, SI handoff at 00:25
- Option B: Wed Dec 15, 08:30–09:30 PT (11:30–12:30 ET) — default host: SI, quick product summary at 00:20
- Option C: Fri Dec 17, 15:00–16:00 PT (18:00–19:00 ET) — fallback for APAC attendees (short Q/A)

Logistics asks:
- Can CloudBridge confirm an SI presenter for the product-deep segment (15m)?
- We’d like a 30-minute rehearsal 48–72 hours prior — can you share availability windows?
- Attach: demo-runbook-v2.pdf (run order, tech checklist). I’ll also attach a SOC2 summary after legal OK.

If none of the above work, suggest two times you prefer and we’ll arbitrate a micro-window (we can do 45m / 30m splits). Goal: lock a single market-facing slot and define a one-click fallback.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

Attachment: demo-runbook-v2.pdf
From: Amanda Chen <amanda@cloudbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Nimbus Data Sales <demo@nimbusdata.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell — micro-window arbitration & rehearsal plan

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear options. Quick notes from CloudBridge side:

- We cannot do Option C (Fri 15:00 PT) — our APAC lead is in EMEA that day.
- Option A looks good in principle but our SI lead (Amanda Chen, same person) has a standing conflict Tue 10:00–11:30 PT.
- We can do Option B but prefer pushing the start to 09:00 PT to give late-ET attendees a nicer window (09:00–10:00 PT).

Rehearsal: we prefer 12/12 or 12/13 between 09:00–11:00 PT for a 30–45m dry run. If Redwood can host the recording, we’ll share a trimmed version with the customer post-demo.

Also: CloudBridge requires a short mutual NDA before we share deeper architecture slides — can you send the template?

Amanda Chen
Partner Lead, CloudBridge
amanda@cloudbridge.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell — micro-window arbitration & rehearsal plan

+1 to Option B with the adjusted start (09:00–10:00 PT) — that gives us a better window for the runtime deep dive and still keeps latency-sensitive bits in front. A couple of technical asks:

- Can CloudBridge confirm whether they need us to present the quantized model latency numbers live? If yes, I’ll bring a small live bench (5–7 min) but that pushes the product deep segment to 20m.
- For host rotation: propose we do a 2-person handoff: Redwood opens (10m), CloudBridge does integration & SI deep dive (20m), Redwood returns for Q/A + billing/cost slide (10m). That stays within 45m.
- Rehearsal: 12/13 09:30–10:15 PT works for me. Recording hosted by Redwood is fine.

Rishi Malhotra

Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 07:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell — micro-window arbitration & rehearsal plan

Thanks everyone — a couple marketplace / ops notes from me:

- Marketplace listing cadence requires a single committed demo date to appear on the co-sell calendar and promotional banner. We should avoid tentative multiple picks.
- If we lock 12/15 09:00–10:00 PT (Option B adjusted), I recommend we set an automatic fallback to 12/17 09:00–10:00 PT and document a one-click swap owner (Vanessa) who can flip the slot if we hit last-minute conflicts.
- Please ensure the runbook has a call tree (who dials in if primary owner drops) — Vanessa can own that.

Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell — micro-window arbitration & rehearsal plan

Thanks — we have consensus. Final summary and immediate next steps: 

Agreed demo slot: 15 Dec 2027, 09:00–10:00 PT (12:00–13:00 ET) — Redwood opens, CloudBridge SI segment mid-run, Redwood closes.
Rehearsal: 13 Dec 2027, 09:30–10:15 PT (recorded; Redwood hosts).
Fallback: one-click fallback to 17 Dec 2027, 09:00–10:00 PT; Vanessa to be fallback owner.
Attendee list (confirm please):
- Redwood: Soojin Lee (sales), Rishi Malhotra (SE), Vanessa Ortiz (partner ops), Karthik Iyer (marketplace)
- CloudBridge: Amanda Chen (partner lead), Tom Li (SI engineer - TBD)
- Nimbus Data: Product Sponsor (TBD)

Immediate asks for CloudBridge / Nimbus:
- Confirm Tom Li (SI engineer) or share an alternate name by EOD 12/09.
- NDA: Amanda — attaching Redwood mutual NDA template and SOC2 summary (SOC2-Summary.pdf) — please return signed or counter by 12/10. DocuSign link for quick sign: https://docusign.example.com/NDAs/DEAL-4921
- Confirm whether you want live latency numbers in-run; if yes, we’ll reserve +7 minutes of the run for an abbreviated bench.

I’ll create the marketplace event in our portal once the NDA is done and Tom is confirmed. Thanks all — excited to get this on the calendar.

Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf, demo-runbook-v2.pdf
